data.title: Mobile plan base price increase to €22.99
data.summary: Muster Mobil GmbH informs Mara Beispiel that the monthly base price of the "Muster Allnet 10 GB" plan rises from €19.99 to €22.99 from 1 February 2026. A special right to cancel applies.
data.explanation: Your mobile provider is raising the monthly base price by €3.00 from 1 February 2026. Everything else stays the same. Because the change is not only to your benefit, you have a special right to cancel (Sonderkündigungsrecht) free of charge within three months of receiving the letter. The contract would end at the earliest when the change takes effect. You may decide whether to accept the new price or cancel; the app shows until when you can cancel. If you do nothing, the new price applies.
